description: Nieuwendammerdijk 135-163 (2022-05-09 strip): single-storey brick dike cottages 4.7 m wide, a low gutter above two separate white-framed casements (1.0 m wide) and a dark door with a transom at the party wall, doors paired across it; a flat-roofed white box dormer 1.5 m high against the party wall over the door side, joined with its neighbour's; red tile roof

match.note: BAG years of this one row are 1905/1935/1960/1984 (renovations); the cottages are identical on the strip, so the type matches on width and the strip, not the year. 3DBAG bouwlagen 3, eaves 6.2-8.4 m and roof max 9.2-10 m are the roofs with their dormers over the road; the 2022-05-09 panorama height drifts 2.2 m on this dike, so the face is re-taken with --camera-height=1.64 and the gutter reads 3.25 m (review-eaves pin)

half-dormer.note: Nieuwendammerdijk 139-153 (2022-05-09): a flush white box dormer about 2.5 m wide, white face, cheeks and fascia, the window filling the front with 0.25 m white posts (no stone ring: palette stone is the same white #f0f0ec; a trim body with no front wall fails the opening-outside audit); against the party wall over the door; joined with the neighbour's

door-left.note: dark single leaf 0.75 m with a transom at the party wall; neighbour mirrors it

rhythm.symmetry: mirror pairs about the party wall; dormers and doors pair across it
rhythm.roofline: white gutter, tiled roof, flat box dormer per pair

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2022-05-09 re-taken with --camera-height=1.64, 40 px/m, 1 m grid: pands 4.7 m; windows 1.05 m wide, sill 0.65 m, head 2.05 m, at 1.3-2.4 and 2.9-3.9 m; door 0.55-1.25 m (head 2.1 m) at the party wall; white gutter 3.25 m; flat white dormer 3.3-5.0 m, two lights, against the party wall

schemaLimits: the white fascia and bracket detail
